name: swiftserve
description: Capability truth and Upgrade Receipts for Swift packages: what dependencies serve and what an update means, grounded in version-pinned source evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Capability truth and SwiftPM Upgrade Receipts
interface.longDescription: Before adding a Swift dependency, ask SwiftServe whether it serves the capability you need. When Package.resolved changes, use an Upgrade Receipt to review versions, pins, policy, health, and exact-version capability impact. Verdicts are derived from parsed source at pinned versions with evidence permalinks, plus dependency-health and private-API checks.
defaultPrompt: Can LiveKit do noise cancellation on macOS? Check SwiftServe before answering.
